mapper.select: SELECT id, run_id, agent_code, user_id, session_id, execution_mode, input_text, input_context, status, output_text, output_metadata, error_code, error_message, duration_ms, started_time, finished_time, created_time, updated_time FROM agent_run WHERE run_id = #{runId} LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE

SELECT run_id FROM agent_run WHERE execution_mode = 'ASYNC' AND ((status = 'PENDING' AND created_time <= #{pendingBefore}) OR (status = 'RUNNING' AND COALESCE(started_time, created_time) <= #{runningBefore})) ORDER BY created_time, id LIMIT #{limit}
